islands.name: Ember Shore
islands.lore: The first lantern-light falls here, where the four tides — joining, taking, folding, sharing — once kept the whole sea in rhythm. The Null silenced them first.
islands.restored: The four tides breathe again. Far off, you hear the Null recoil — it did not expect anyone to remember how to count.

skills.name: Tide of Joining
skills.desc: Addition, from shore-counting to triple swells.
skills.numenLore: Hums two songs into one.
tips: Round, then repair: 297 + 58 → 300 + 58, then give back 3.
Add left to right: tens first, then ones. 47 + 38 → 70, then 15 → 85.

skills.name: Tide of Taking
skills.desc: Subtraction and what the ebb leaves behind.
skills.numenLore: Keeps what remains when the tide pulls out.
tips: Count up, not down: 83 − 47 → from 47, add 3 to reach 50, then 33 more.
Round what you subtract: −29 becomes −30, then hand 1 back.

skills.name: Tide of Folding
skills.numenLore: Beats its wings in perfect multiples.
tips: Break a factor apart: 7 × 46 = 7×40 + 7×6.
×5 is ×10 then half. ×9 is ×10 minus one of them.

skills.name: Tide of Sharing
skills.desc: Division into fair and perfect piles.
skills.numenLore: Shares every catch into fair piles.
tips: Divide in steps: ÷6 is ÷2, then ÷3.
Ask how many whole TENS of the divisor fit first, then finish the rest.

islands.name: Hollow of Signs
islands.lore: A cavern where the sea dips below zero. Lanterns here burn cold, and every number casts a mirrored twin on the dark water.
islands.restored: The zero-line steadies. Positive and negative walk the hollow together now, politely, like old rivals who respect each other.

skills.name: Mirrorwalk
skills.numenLore: Walks both sides of zero without falling.
tips: Think temperature: −7 + 10 is warming 10° from −7, landing at 3.
Subtracting a negative removes a debt — that always makes you richer.

skills.name: Twin Product
skills.numenLore: Two wrongs, it insists, make a right.
tips: Count the minus signs: an even count turns positive, odd stays negative.
Ignore the signs, multiply the sizes, restore the sign at the very end.

skills.name: Rite of Order
skills.desc: Order of operations — the sacred sequence.
skills.numenLore: Never does anything out of turn.
tips: Scan before you compute: circle every × and ÷ first; + and − wait their turn.
Exponents outrank everything except parentheses.

islands.name: Fraction Cove
islands.lore: Every wave here breaks into perfect parts. The cove-folk once traded in halves and fifths the way others trade in shells.
islands.restored: The divided waters flow whole again. A fifth of a wave, you now know, is still entirely a wave.

skills.name: Shedding Rite
skills.numenLore: Sheds everything it doesn’t need.
tips: Both even? Halve both. One ends in 0 or 5 and so does the other? Try 5.
Digit-sum trick: if both digit-sums divide by 3, the whole fraction does.

skills.name: Common Ground
skills.numenLore: Finds the ground two rivers share.
tips: Same bottom? Add only the tops — the bottom never adds.
A quick common bottom is one denominator times the other; simplify after.

skills.name: Somersault Rule
skills.numenLore: Divides by turning somersaults.
tips: Cancel before you multiply: cross-simplify any top with any bottom.
To divide, flip the second fraction and multiply. Every time, no exceptions.

islands.name: The Glass Delta
islands.lore: A river-mouth of glass where numbers refract into tenths and hundredths. Merchants here measure everything — including gratitude — in percent.
islands.restored: The delta runs clear. You can read a price tag, a tip, and a trick discount at a glance, which frightens merchants everywhere.

skills.name: Glasswork
skills.desc: Decimal arithmetic with a steady hand.
skills.numenLore: Carries her point wherever she drifts.
tips: Think in money: 3.4 + 2.8 is $3.40 + $2.80.
For ×, drop the points, multiply whole numbers, then place the decimals back.

skills.name: Hundredfold Eye
skills.desc: Percent of a quantity, part and whole.
skills.numenLore: Sees every whole as a hundred sparks.
tips: Find 10% by sliding the point left; 5% is half of that, 20% is double.
p% of n equals n% of p: 8% of 50 = 50% of 8 = 4.

skills.name: Turning Tide
skills.numenLore: Measures how far the tide has turned.
tips: +20% is one multiply: ×1.2. And −20% is ×0.8.
Chained changes multiply: +10% then −10% is ×1.1 × 0.9 = ×0.99 — not zero.

islands.name: Ratio Reef
islands.lore: Coral that grows in strict proportion — three arms of red for every five of gold. Break the ratio and the reef breaks you.
islands.restored: The reef rebuilds itself arm by arm, three to five, exactly as the old law says. It hums when you swim past.

skills.name: Price of One
skills.desc: Unit rates — per one, per hour, per lumin.
skills.numenLore: Asks the price of one, always.
tips: Always price ONE first: total ÷ count, then scale.
Compare per-one prices, never the sticker prices.

skills.name: Reef Law
skills.numenLore: If this is to that, it already knows the rest.
tips: Cross-multiply: in a/b = c/d, the diagonals a·d and b·c are equal.
Ask how the known pair scaled; the unknown pair scales identically.

skills.name: Cartography
skills.numenLore: Grows and shrinks but never distorts.
tips: Scale factor = new ÷ old, always in that order.
Lengths scale by s, areas by s², volumes by s³.

islands.name: Exponent Peaks
islands.lore: Mountains that double in height with every step of the climb. The peak-keepers wrote the width of the sea on a grain of sand, in a notation of their own.
islands.restored: The doubling stairs stand firm. From the summit you can see numbers too large to say aloud — and now, how to write them small.

skills.name: Staircount
skills.numenLore: Stacks its acorns in perfect squares.
tips: Squares near round numbers: 19² = (20−1)² = 400 − 40 + 1.
Keep anchors in your pocket: 2¹⁰ = 1024, 15² = 225, 25² = 625.

skills.name: Keepers’ Laws
skills.numenLore: Adds journeys by multiplying steps.
tips: Same base multiplied? ADD exponents. A power of a power? MULTIPLY them.
x⁰ = 1 — a journey of zero steps still stands somewhere.

skills.name: Grain-Script
skills.numenLore: Writes the width of the sea on a grain of sand.
tips: Count point-slides, not zeros. Slides left = positive exponent.
Multiply the fronts, add the exponents; re-slide once if the front reaches 10.

islands.name: Algebra Vale
islands.lore: A green valley where one traveler is always missing from every story, known only as x. The vale-folk have hunted the hidden letter for a thousand years.
islands.restored: The hidden letter steps out of the mist and bows. It was never hiding, it says — you simply hadn’t balanced the question.

skills.name: First Unmasking
skills.numenLore: Hides in plain sight and waits to be found.
tips: Don’t solve — UNDO. Whatever touches x, do the opposite to both sides.
Check by feeding the answer back in; it should balance in your head.

skills.name: The Balancing
skills.numenLore: Sleeps only when both pans are level.
tips: Peel in reverse order: undo + and − first, × and ÷ last.
x on both sides? Subtract the smaller x-term from each side first.

skills.name: Open Doors
skills.numenLore: Opens every door she is handed.
tips: The outside number multiplies EVERY term inside — count the terms.
(x+a)(x+b): the middle number is a+b, the last is a·b.

islands.name: Geometry Grove
islands.lore: Trees that grow in perfect polygons; a grove floor tiled without a single gap. The oldest tree is a right triangle, and it is very proud of its longest side.
islands.restored: The grove measures itself again — every angle accounted for, every shortcut proven. The old triangle creaks approvingly.

skills.name: Tilewright
skills.numenLore: Tiles the shore without a single gap.
tips: Composite shape? Cut it into rectangles — or subtract the hole.
A triangle is half its bounding rectangle. That is the whole story of ½bh.

skills.name: Degreecraft
skills.numenLore: Bows at exactly the right degree.
tips: Anchor to three facts: line 180°, turn 360°, triangle 180°.
Regular n-gon: each exterior angle is 360/n; the interior is its supplement.

skills.name: The Long Side
skills.numenLore: Takes the shortcut, and proves it.
tips: Know the families: 3-4-5, 5-12-13, 8-15-17 — and every multiple of them.
The hypotenuse sits alone: c² = a² + b², never mixed in with a leg.

islands.name: Function Falls
islands.lore: A waterfall that takes what you throw in and returns it transformed — always by the same rule. Feed it a 3, learn its secret.
islands.restored: The falls run every rule you ask of them: lines, curves, and two truths crossing. The water applauds, which is unusual for water.

skills.name: Line-Reading
skills.numenLore: Climbs the same rise for every run.
tips: Slope is rise over run: subtract the y’s over the x’s, same order.
In y = mx + b: b is where you start, m is how you move.

skills.name: Arc of Falling
skills.numenLore: Falls, and turns falling into flight.
tips: Factoring x² + bx + c: find two numbers that MULTIPLY to c, ADD to b.
The vertex hides at x = −b/2a — symmetry gives it away.

skills.name: Two Truths
skills.numenLore: Speaks two truths and lives where they cross.
tips: Stack the equations and subtract — one letter should vanish.
If an equation hands you y alone, substitute it in; don’t fight it.

islands.name: Trig Temple
islands.lore: A ring-temple where monks dance the unit circle at dawn, each step a sixth of π. They measure the world with triangles and modesty.
islands.restored: The circle dance turns unbroken, dawn after dawn. You know every step now — and every step’s sine.

skills.name: Triangle Sight
skills.desc: Sine, cosine, tangent in right triangles.
skills.numenLore: Sees the whole triangle in one angle.
tips: SOH-CAH-TOA — pick the two sides your angle can actually see.
Ratios carry no units: a 3-4-5 answer holds at any size.

skills.name: The Round Dance
skills.desc: The unit circle, radians, exact values.
skills.numenLore: Dances the circle in steps of π.
tips: The 30-45-60 sines just count up: √1/2, √2/2, √3/2.
Cosine is the x-shadow, sine the y-shadow, of a point walking the circle.

skills.name: Many Faces
skills.numenLore: Wears many faces, all of them equal.
tips: sin² + cos² = 1 turns either ratio into the other.
One answer per quadrant where the sign fits — sketch the circle first.

islands.name: Chance Mire
islands.lore: A marsh where nothing is certain and everything is likely. The mire-witches deal cards, roll bones, and are never, ever surprised.
islands.restored: The fog thins to exactly the thickness you’d expect, on average. The witches deal you in; you know the odds before the cards land.

skills.name: Bonecasting
skills.desc: Probability of events, single and chained.
skills.numenLore: Never certain, never surprised.
tips: Probability = wanted ÷ possible. Count both before you divide.
“And” multiplies; “or” adds (when the events can’t both happen).

skills.name: Every Way
skills.numenLore: Knows every way the story could go.
tips: Draw a blank slot per choice, fill in the counts, multiply across.
Order matters → permutation. Only the group matters → divide the repeats out.

skills.name: Middle Ground
skills.desc: Mean, median, and reading a crowd.
skills.numenLore: Stands in the middle of every crowd.
tips: The mean is a balance point: total = mean × count. Use that backwards.
The median needs sorted data — sort first, then take the middle.

islands.name: Calculus Caldera
islands.lore: The volcano at the top of the world, where the Null has made its throne. Here motion itself is studied: the art of the instant, and the sum of infinite whispers.
islands.restored: The caldera cools. The Null, unsolved at last, thins into ordinary night sky — and every star above Numera is a Numen, home. You are the Grand Mathfinder.

skills.name: The Approach
skills.numenLore: Forever arriving, never quite there.
tips: Try substituting first — most limits simply want the value there.
Got 0/0? Something cancels. Factor and look for the hole.

skills.name: Art of the Instant
skills.numenLore: Feels the world change as it happens.
tips: Power rule chant: bring it down in front, drop the power by one.
A derivative is a slope — sanity-check its sign against the graph in your head.

skills.name: Infinite Whispers
skills.numenLore: Gathers infinite whispers into one voice.
tips: Integrate = reverse power rule: raise by one, divide by the new power.
A definite integral is area — estimate with a rectangle to sanity-check.

shop.name: Lens of Insight
shop.desc: Five hint-charges, ground from clear quartz.

shop.name: Streak Shield
shop.desc: Guards your daily flame through one missed day. (max 2)

shop.name: Comet Boost
shop.desc: Double XP for your next trial.
